speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Let me ask you a question. Do you believe you're going to go to hell for eating sweet and sour pork?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Jews don't have hell. We have acid reflux.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Do you want the last dumpling, Sheldon?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Certainly. It's not like I have to moderate my food intake because I'm planning on eating again very shortly. Mm, mm, mm!

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: So, you guys want to do something tonight?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Nah, I can't. I got to pick up my mom from her water aerobics class. 18 overweight women flapping their arm fat in a swimming pool. Looks like the manatee tank at Sea World.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Oh, there it is, now that you don't have a girlfriend, you want to hang out with me again.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I never stopped hanging out with you.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Oh, please, we all know I'm the friend you call when you have no other options. If we were the Justice League, I'd be Aquaman.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I wish you were Aquaman. Then I could send you to scoop my mom out of the old lady tank.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Excuse me, I'm thirsty, so I'm going to go to the refrigerator and get myself a refreshing beverage.
